items.name: pi-model-router
items.description: Extension for the pi coding agent that intelligently routes each turn to the right LLM tier (high/medium/low) based on task intent, session budget, context size, and custom rules.

items.name: PC_Workman_HCK
items.description: System monitor with offline AI (82 intents, 9-layer routing) that learns YOUR PC. TURBO optimization, thermal baselines, voltage SPC, ghost driver detection, 373 process definitions. optimization features, 11 months solo. No cloud, no API, your data stays local. MIT licensed. - Marcin HCK Firmuga - Build in Public (3 days series every week)

items.description: Logic-based multi-LLM voice router for Home Assistant, combining native intents, local Qwen, GPU-aware desktop Ollama, and cloud AI with intelligent fallback.

items.name: agent-config
items.description: Skills, rules, slash commands and subagents for Claude Code, routed by intent and compiled into other coding agents — every claim machine-checked, including the artifact counts in these badges.

items.name: arbetern
items.description: Enterprise AI orchestration platform and Slack runtime deploying specialized, domain-expert agents. By decoupling agent definitions from the routing engine, Arbetern dynamically assigns LLMs and feature-gated tool palettes based on real-time user intent, empowering them to autonomously modify code, analyze data, and manage complex enterprise tasks.
